entry.name: bgcolor
entry.description: Set the background color of the patcher window. The bgcolor object's functionality is equivalent to a brgb message sent to thispatcher.

arguments.name: red
arguments.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the red value for the background color of the patcher.

arguments.name: green
arguments.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the green value for the background color of the patcher.

arguments.name: blue
arguments.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the blue value for the background color of the patcher.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: will reset the patcher's background to the RGB values most currently received by.

messages.name: ft3
messages.description: A floating-point number in the range 0.0 to 1.0 sets the alpha value of the patcher background color.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the green value of the patcher background color.

messages.name: in2
messages.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the blue value of the patcher background color.

messages.name: int
messages.description: A number in the range 0-255 sets the red value of the patcher background color.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of three numbers in the range 0-255 sets the background color of the patcher in RGB format.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a list of three numbers in the range 0-255 sets the background color of the patcher in RGB format.
